name: Okuda Ewan
source:
An engineer serving as Asuma’s assistant at Gai Institution; 32 years old.

Ewan recognizes Asuma’s talent as the genuine article, and thus follows his orders without question—no matter if he’s belittled or ridiculed.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
